evidence_rules: Pre-2013 ratings use only the Tennis Europe retrospective that tennis was traditionally a very small sport in the Faroe Islands.
The 2013 Island Games establishes organised competitive presence before the national federation, not federation-era international membership.
Federation identity begins in 2017 and is never backcast.
Tennis Europe and ITF membership are gated to 2026; current international integration does not rewrite earlier decades.
Small-population participation is not treated as world-leading national scale, and no competition outcome is a calibration target.
